chessinstruct.validity_rule: Items whose released gold fails a mechanical python-chess check against the generator's own semantics (best move not legal for the side to move; last move illegal or contradicting the result; final score contradicting a terminal position; illegal move history), or whose answer is visible in the input (MLM_ON_MOVES without '?' masks; SORT_FENS inputs already in gold order), are dropped before exclusion; the 200 budget is refilled by the spec round-robin (seed 20261031) over the remaining valid items/task types.
